title: SAP Basis Admin
description:
**About Cencora**
-----------------

Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

**Job Details**
===============

SAP Basis Administrator

POSITION SUMMARY:

SAP Systems Administrators are responsible for maintaining the ongoing reliability, performance, management and support of the SAP systems environment. SAP environments may include but are not limited to: Administration, Sales, Distribution, etc. Responsibilities include managing applications and systems, responding to problems and planning for growth. SAP Systems Administrators understand the technical infrastructure standards and requirements for the integration of specific SAP modules. This may include migration tasks such as change request review, software build coordination, release documentation, production issue resolution and tracking report distribution. They also understand the business implications of application and system problems allowing them to appropriately set severity levels when problems do occur. SAP Systems Administrators monitor the performance of system applications. Individuals execute contingency plans in case of system outages, troubleshoot a wide variety of technical problems and provide Level II support to the Help Desk. In addition, these roles participate in projects to implement SAP services such as initial installation, as well as subsequent installations of updates and patches.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Follows manager in projects and is responsible for deliverables.
* Works on multiple, high to highly complex projects.
* Maintains SAP systems and applications, supporting and training users for SAP system(s) and applications usage.
* Supports integration of changes in test, pre-production and production environments.
* Works with production quality assurance/testing team to ensure appropriate level of testing has been completed prior to implementation of change.
* Works on the installation of upgrades and patches for the enterprise SAP system.
* Follows all necessary technical checklists to ensure completion of upgrades.
* Participates in system-wide updates, upgrades and fixes.
* Ensures the performance and reliability of SAP systems.
* Assesses risk of implemented changes before performing them.
* Responds to escalated system problems.
* Monitors and maintains a comprehensive set of performance metrics for all system features.
* Identifies risk levels and recommends and implements corrective/preventive actions.
* Maintains history reports, identifies and addresses re-occurring problems.
* Creates automation scripts for efficiency and process improvement.
* Prepares documentation for customer support, such as server and client hardware/software configurations and network configurations.
* Can act as a leader for SAP projects
* Coaches less experienced staff.
* Role will require 1 week of on-call every 2 months. Will also require 1 weekend a month for support as well.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or other related field or equivalent work experience.
* Typically has 5 or more years of business and/or SAP implementation experience.
* Experience with systems and database administration.
* Requires experience with implementation, operating, and performance management of several of the following: SAP S/4 HANA, SAP PO, SAP Fiori, SAP Solution Manger, SAP BTP, SAP LVM, SAP HANA Cockpit, SAP SLT, SAP DS/IS, SAP ECC system on Oracle Database & SAP HANA in On-Prem and Public cloud such as Azure, GCP, AWS

MINIMUM SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITY REQUIREMENTS:

* Requires skills in multiple technical environments and knowledge of a specific business area.
* Requires certification in specific areas (i.e., Basis, Oracle, Hana).
* Strong organization skills
* Good analytical and problem solving skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing
* Exceptional customer service skills
* Good interpersonal skills; solid team player
* Knowledge of client/server technology.
* Experience across multiple SAP software products. (e.g. ECC, BW, PI)
* Good group presentation skills
* Exceptional customer service skills
* Extensive knowledge of troubleshooting complex SAP performance problems.

.

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
### **Description**

You will report directly to the Infrastructure Engineering Manager in a newly formed SME team. Providing the group Service Ops team with support and expertise on all aspects of the databases & applications.  
  
You will constantly identify opportunities to improve our service to our customer base, so that SLAs are exceeded, and customer feedback is consistently high.

Troubleshoot data quality and consistency problems which may result in application issues.

Provide aid to colleagues across the business with any issues related to our databases and applications, including support of Development, Testing and Internal systems.

This role requires expertise across both on-premises SQL Server and Azure-hosted database services, to ensure consistent support, monitoring and resilience regardless of where a database is hosted.

Work with the Infrastructure Ops, Infrastructure Engineering and Application Ops where required, to provide input and expertise on the strategic direction of our platforms and systems.

From time to time the role will also undertake specific project activities.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* To maintain a high level of Database and Application availability & performance. This will be done by monitoring, measuring, and improving the database schema & queries wherever possible.
* Manage the monitoring of all SQL databases and servers to ensure that we are alerted to performance issues prior to them impacting customers.
* Provide support to both Internal & External customers, assisting with the ParentPay database / data queries and related data quality and application problems.
* Undertake capacity planning to ensure that there is adequate capacity within the system to cope with long term growth plans and peak trading period.
* Work with Development to ensure that bottlenecks that might affect performance are identified and eliminated.
* Assist with the production of ad-hoc reporting for management and external customers via data extract or SRS report production.
* Ensure data security and best practices are maintained, including evidence of backup schedules, encryption, retention and restore testing.
* Introduce new tools and methodologies to improve efficiency across the estate.
* Support SQL Server instances through their lifecycle (maintain, update, migrate), on-premises and in Azure.
* Ensure incidents, tasks and changes are accurately documented and progressed in ServiceNow.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Proven experience of at least two years as a database administrator in an enterprise environment, with the ability to create and optimize SQL queries and stored procedures, using SQL Server and T-SQL
* Working knowledge of database monitoring tools across both on-premises and Azure-hosted environments.
* Working knowledge of ITSM tooling for accurate documentation and progression of incidents, tasks and changes.
* Awareness of backup/DR requirements, including encryption, retention and restore-testing practices, across on-premises and Azure-hosted databases.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Experience in performing migrations/upgrades of SQL Server
* Knowledge of infrastructure (compute, storage, networks), primarily on-premises with growing exposure to Azure-hosted database services.
* Ability to take personal responsibility for training and self-development

  

### **About ParentPay Group**

At ParentPay Group, we believe that when schools run well, students thrive. That’s why we’ve spent decades building the operating system that supports well‑run schools – a seamless layer of tools, insights, and support that makes school life simpler for teachers, leaders, caterers, parents, and students alike.

From cashless payments and parent engagement to catering management, library systems, and MIS platforms, we connect the everyday parts of education through simple, secure, and connected tools. What began as a way to make school payments easier has grown into Europe’s leading EdTech group – trusted by over 20,000 schools and 9 million users across the UK and Europe.

Every day, our platforms process millions of payments, messages, and data points, quietly working in the background so schools can shine out front. Together, we’re helping schools save time, cut costs, and create more time for learning.

ParentPay Group is more than a collection of brands. We are a group of people dedicated to supporting well‑run schools and giving time back to teachers, parents, caterers, admin staff – and most importantly, to students.

**What you'll do:** **Cloud Monitoring Administrator** in the **Enterprise** will…

We are hiring an Associate to administer our SolarWinds platform and monitor Windows, Linux, network and application infrastructure. You will build and tune monitoring, act first on alerts, and log in to servers to investigate and resolve issues before they affect users.

**SolarWinds administration**

* Install, configure, upgrade and maintain SolarWinds Orion / Hybrid Cloud Observability modules (NPM, SAM, SCM, NTA, NCM, WPM, Log Analyzer).
* Add and manage nodes, interfaces, volumes and application templates; discover new devices via Network Sonar.
* Create and tune alerts, thresholds, dependencies and escalation rules to reduce noise and false positives.
* Build custom dashboards, views and scheduled reports for operations and management.
* Manage polling engines, agents (agent-based and agentless), WMI/SNMP credentials and platform health.
* Perform routine maintenance: database cleanup, license tracking, certificate and service checks, backups.

**Infrastructure monitoring**

* Monitor Windows and Linux servers for CPU, memory, disk, services, processes and event logs.
* Monitor applications such as IIS, SQL Server, Apache/Tomcat, Active Directory, Exchange and custom services.
* Monitor network devices (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, wireless controllers) for availability, interface utilization, bandwidth, errors and latency.
* Respond to alerts 24x7 in shifts, triage incidents, and escalate to L2/L3 or application teams with clear diagnostics.
* Onboard new servers and applications into monitoring as per the change process.

**Hands-on server work**

* Log in to Windows servers (RDP) and Linux servers (SSH) to validate alerts and perform first-level troubleshooting.
* Check and restart services, review logs, clear disk space, and verify connectivity (ping, traceroute, telnet, nslookup).
* Install and troubleshoot SolarWinds agents, SNMP and WMI configuration on servers.

**Process and documentation**

* Create and update tickets in ITSM tools (ServiceNow or Jira) within SLA.
* Maintain SOPs, runbooks and monitoring inventory; share shift handovers and daily health reports.
* Support audits, patching windows and maintenance mode scheduling.

**What you’ll bring:**

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience as a SolarWinds administrator.
* Knowledge of monitoring tools, such as Nagios, Zabbix, PRTG, SCOM, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Datadog, New Relic, Splunk or Grafana/Prometheus.
* Proven experience monitoring Windows servers, Linux servers, network devices (routers, switches, firewalls) and business applications.
* Hands-on server experience: has logged in to servers via RDP and SSH and performed basic tasks independently.
* Basic Windows Server administration: services, Event Viewer, Task Manager, disk management, IIS basics, user and permission checks.
* Basic Linux administration: common commands (top, df, du, free, ps, grep, systemctl, journalctl), file permissions and log navigation.
* Understanding of SNMP, WMI, ICMP and agent-based polling, plus networking basics (TCP/IP, DNS, ports, firewalls).
* Familiarity with ITIL incident, change and problem processes and an ITSM ticketing tool.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including weekends when rostered.
* Fluency in English
* Client-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

description:

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

CIB MSS Securities Services (SSV) Infrastructure Team is responsible for delivery of IT infrastructure needs for SSv business needs globally. The current team has strong infrastructure skills and experience across our globally distributed SMEs spread across (Canada, U.K, India and HongKong). To maintain our professional level of Database Administration and Automation service, we need an individual who should possess a strong blend of development tooling experience and methodologies, coupled with an awareness of infrastructure technologies and ITIL processes.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering

**In this role, you will:**

  

* Administer and support Oracle and PostgreSQL database platforms across development, test and production environments, including installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, backup and recovery, monitoring, and performance tuning.

  

* Design and implement infrastructure automation solutions in line with Group standards for database and platform operations, including provisioning, configuration, patching, health checks, capacity reporting, and vulnerability remediation.

  

* Support Oracle high-availability and disaster-recovery technologies, including RAC, Data Guard, and multitenant architecture, as well as relevant PostgreSQL resilience and recovery solutions.

  

* Investigate database and automation-service incidents, lead technical troubleshooting where required, identify root causes, and implement sustainable preventive measures.

  

* Develop reusable, production-ready scripts and automation workflows using Rundeck, Ansible, and related tools such as Terraform, Jenkins, and GitHub, with appropriate testing, logging, error handling, security controls, and documentation.

  

* Partner with infrastructure, application, security, and service-management teams to integrate automation into operational processes and improve service resilience.

  

* Maintain technical documentation, automation runbooks, and support procedures, and contribute to knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and a strong engineering culture.

**To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:**

  

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.

  

* At least 10 years’ hands-on experience in database administration, with strong expertise in Oracle and PostgreSQL, including installation, configuration, monitoring, patching, upgrades, backup and recovery, performance tuning, troubleshooting, high availability, disaster recovery and resilience. Practical experience with Oracle RAC, Data Guard and multitenant architecture is required.

  

* Experience with Delphix, Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Exadata and cloud technologies is advantageous. Good working knowledge of Unix/Linux and Windows platforms, enterprise monitoring, job scheduling and storage technologies, including tools such as BMC Patrol and Control-M, as well as SAN environments.

  

* Familiarity with approved AI-assisted development or operational tools is required. Good understanding ofthe business benefits, limitations and potential risks of AI technologies.

  

* Demonstrable experience in designing, developing, testing and supporting infrastructure automation solutions, with strong hands-on experience in Rundeck and/or Ansible, plus knowledge of at least one additional tool such as GitHub, Grafana, Jenkins or HashiCorp Vault.

  

* Good coding and scripting capability in Python, Shell, PowerShell, SQL and Git, together with experience integrating with APIs and the ability to create maintainable, reusable and production-ready infrastructure automation.

  

* Practical experience in incident, crisis and problem management, including root-cause analysis, risk-based decision-making and the implementation of preventive measures.

  

* Strong ownership, a sense of urgency, analytical and communication skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to processes, security, compliance and operational controls.

title: Lead Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Lead Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Oracle RAC**

**Self-Managed Oracle RAC | HA/DR | Performance | Automation | Engineering Influence**

**Level**

Lead DBRE

**Domain**

Oracle RAC and Mission-Critical Relational Infrastructure

**Primary Focus**

Hands-on Oracle RAC reliability, lifecycle ownership, technical escalation, automation, application partnership, and cross-functional execution

**Work Expectations**

U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required

**1. Role Summary**
===================

We are seeking an experienced Lead DBRE with deep hands-on expertise in Oracle Database and self-managed Oracle RAC environments. The role owns technical execution for a major Oracle domain and improves reliability, performance, scalability, lifecycle management, automation, and operational discipline.

Beyond traditional DBA operations, the Lead DBRE partners with application and infrastructure teams to influence schema, SQL, connection management, resiliency, observability, and safe deployment practices. The role remains hands-on while providing technical leadership, mentoring, and incident escalation.

**2. Level Scope and Leadership Expectations**
==============================================

Lead DBRE is a senior technical leadership role focused on owning execution for a major database domain. The expectation is to solve difficult production problems, lead initiatives end to end, guide engineers, create durable operating standards, and drive cross-functional closure without default people-management responsibility.

**Dimension**

**Expectation at This Level**

**Scope of Ownership**

Owns reliability and execution for a significant Oracle platform domain, including incidents, lifecycle activities, routine maintenance, capacity risks, HA/DR readiness, and service-impacting improvements.

**Technical Depth**

Diagnoses complex RAC, Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, SQL performance, storage, interconnect, OS, backup, and recovery problems.

**Technical Leadership**

Acts as a primary escalation point, mentors engineers, reviews designs, raises standards, and influences application and infrastructure decisions.

**Execution**

Leads complex initiatives end to end, aligns stakeholders, manages dependencies, and drives permanent corrective actions to closure.

**Communication**

Explains technical tradeoffs, communicates clearly during incidents, and keeps risks, ownership, dependencies, and timelines visible.

**Automation and Standards**

Builds repeatable automation, CI/CD practices, runbooks, monitoring, and golden paths that reduce toil and failure risk.

**3. Key Responsibilities**
===========================

**A. Oracle RAC Platform Ownership**
------------------------------------

* Administer and improve Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, Clusterware, ASM, services, SCAN/listeners, and interconnect configurations.
* Plan and execute patching, upgrades, migrations, capacity changes, and lifecycle activities with controlled change and rollback practices.
* Design, operate, and validate Data Guard, RMAN, backup/recovery, failover, switchover, and disaster-recovery procedures.

**B. Performance and Incident Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Lead performance analysis using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, execution plans, SQL Trace, TKPROF, and OS/storage diagnostics.
* Diagnose Cache Fusion, GC waits, workload placement, connection storms, cluster instability, storage latency, and interconnect issues.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for critical incidents, lead stabilization and RCA, and drive permanent corrective actions.

**C. Engineering Influence and Shift-Left Reliability**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Partner with application teams on SQL, indexing, partitioning, schema design, bind usage, connection pooling, transaction boundaries, and resilient failover behavior.
* Establish database design reviews, deployment guardrails, developer guidance, and production-readiness standards.

**D. Automation and Observability**
-----------------------------------

* Automate provisioning, validation, patching, maintenance, backup checks, DR exercises, health checks, and recurring remediation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
* Improve Oracle observability using OEM, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, or comparable tools; define actionable service indicators and objectives.

**4. Required Qualifications and Experience**
=============================================

* 8+ years of database or reliability engineering experience, including significant Lead or Senior responsibility for self-managed production Oracle RAC.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure/Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, RAC Services, SCAN/listeners, Cache Fusion, and interconnect behavior.
* Strong Oracle performance tuning and diagnostics experience using AWR, ASH, execution plans, SQL Trace, and Linux diagnostics.
* Experience with patching, upgrades, migrations, backup/recovery, DR exercises, and controlled production change.
* Strong Linux/Unix systems troubleshooting skills.
* Hands-on automation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or comparable tooling.
* Strong technical leadership, mentoring, incident communication, and cross-functional execution skills.

**5. Preferred Qualifications**
===============================

* Oracle Exadata, OCI, Cloud@Customer, AWS, or hybrid Oracle deployment experience.
* Application Continuity, FAN, TAF, FSFO, Far Sync, GoldenGate, GDS, TDE, ZDLRA, or advanced Oracle HA capabilities.
* Database schema CI/CD using Liquibase, Flyway, Bytebase, or comparable tooling.
* Oracle certifications or relevant SRE/cloud architecture credentials.

**6. Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months**
=================================================

* Establish measurable reliability, MTTR, patching, backup/recovery, and DR-readiness baselines and deliver material improvement.
* Automate high-frequency and high-risk operational workflows, prioritizing safety, maintainability, and auditability.
* Establish a practical database architecture and production-readiness review process with measurable adoption by application teams.
* Deliver documented capacity, lifecycle, resiliency, and corrective-action plans for critical RAC environments.

**7. What This Role Does Not Include**
======================================

* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is expected through technical direction, mentoring, and execution ownership.
* This is not a project-management-only role; the Lead DBRE must remain deeply hands-on.
* This is not a traditional DBA ticket queue; durable fixes, automation, standards, capacity planning, and reliability improvements are expected.
* This role does not own application code or business logic, although it influences database-impacting application design.
* The role does not assume unlimited or last-minute DBRE capacity; work must be planned, prioritized, communicated, and committed through the appropriate process.

**8. Work Expectations and Location**
=====================================

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

title: Staff Database Reliability Engineer
description:

**OpenSearch Must-Have | Distributed Systems | Kafka | Redis | Capacity Engineering | Automation**

**Level**

Staff DBRE (Senior Individual Contributor / Technical Lead)

**Domain**

Distributed Data Platforms

**Primary Focus**

Cross-team architecture and systemic reliability for OpenSearch-centered data platforms, with Kafka, Redis, capacity engineering, and Python automation

**Work Expectations**

U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required

**1. Role Summary**
===================

We are seeking an experienced Staff DBRE with deep OpenSearch/Elasticsearch expertise and strong distributed-systems judgment. The role leads high-impact architecture, reliability, performance, scalability, capacity, and lifecycle improvements across major data-platform services, complemented by Kafka, Redis, Linux, observability, and Python automation.

The Staff DBRE solves ambiguous cross-team problems, establishes reusable platform patterns, mentors senior engineers, and influences multiple engineering groups. The scope extends beyond a single cluster or incident while remaining hands-on and evidence-driven.

**2. Level Scope and Leadership Expectations**
==============================================

Staff DBRE is a senior individual-contributor technical leadership role focused on solving ambiguous, high-impact reliability and architecture problems across platforms and teams. The role has broad influence within the data-platform domain, while enterprise-wide cross-domain strategy remains a Principal-level responsibility.

**Dimension**

**Expectation at This Level**

**Scope of Ownership**

Owns complex cross-team reliability, scalability, performance, capacity, architecture, and operational-maturity problems across major OpenSearch-centered platform services.

**Technical Depth**

Serves as a domain authority in OpenSearch and distributed-systems failure modes, with strong supporting depth in Kafka, Redis, JVM, Linux, storage, and networking.

**Engineering Leadership**

Defines platform-domain patterns, mentors Senior and Lead engineers, raises design-review and incident-analysis rigor, and influences adjacent teams.

**Automation Architecture**

Designs reusable Python automation, observability, validation, and lifecycle-management patterns rather than isolated scripts.

**Execution**

Drives ambiguous initiatives from problem framing through design, alignment, implementation guidance, and measurable outcomes.

**Organizational Influence**

Influences multiple engineering groups through data, production evidence, design standards, and technical judgment; does not unilaterally set enterprise strategy.

**3. Key Responsibilities**
===========================

**A. OpenSearch Platform Architecture**
---------------------------------------

* Design and improve large-scale OpenSearch/Elasticsearch topology, dedicated node roles, shard and index strategies, lifecycle management, workload distribution, and recovery patterns.
* Solve complex indexing, search, cluster-state, JVM/GC, storage, segment, mapping, allocation, and cross-cluster reliability problems.
* Establish domain-level resilience, snapshot, replication, upgrade, and capacity patterns appropriate to the actual scale of the environment.

**B. Kafka and Redis Reliability**
----------------------------------

* Guide Kafka topology, partitioning, replication, capacity, consumer reliability, and failure-mode remediation for critical services.
* Guide Redis Cluster and Sentinel architecture, memory and eviction behavior, persistence tradeoffs, failover, re-sharding, and client reliability.

**C. Automation, Observability, and Capacity Engineering**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Architect reusable Python tooling and safe remediation frameworks for provisioning, validation, maintenance, scaling, and incident prevention.
* Define domain-level observability, SLIs/SLOs, capacity models, lifecycle forecasts, and actionable risk thresholds.
* Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and operator patterns where they improve repeatability and supportability.

**D. Technical Strategy and Cross-Team Leadership**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead architecture and production-readiness reviews for the data-platform domain.
* Evaluate emerging technologies through workload-relevant benchmarks, failure testing, operability reviews, and total-cost considerations.
* Lead complex technical investigations and systemic corrective actions; mentor engineers and improve engineering practices across teams.

**4. Required Qualifications and Experience**
=============================================

* 8+ years of DBRE, SRE, database, or distributed data-platform engineering experience with Staff, Lead, or comparable technical leadership scope.
* Deep hands-on mastery of OpenSearch and/or Elasticsearch internals, operations, performance, lifecycle management, recovery, and architecture.
* Strong production experience with Kafka and/or Redis, with the ability to reason across distributed data-platform failure modes.
* Strong systems expertise across JVM, Linux, CPU, memory, storage I/O, networking, and capacity behavior.
* Strong Python software-engineering capability for reusable production automation and tooling.
* Demonstrated success solving ambiguous cross-team technical problems and influencing architecture through evidence and judgment.
* Strong incident leadership, written communication, mentoring, and design-review skills.

**5. Preferred Qualifications**
===============================

* Experience with both Kafka and Redis at meaningful production scale.
* Kubernetes operators, Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, and cloud-managed data services.
* Experience evaluating ClickHouse, Pinot, vector databases, or stream-processing technologies.
* Experience with chaos testing, production-readiness reviews, and cost-aware capacity engineering.

**6. Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months**
=================================================

* Establish measurable reliability, capacity, lifecycle, and operational-maturity baselines for critical data-platform services and lead material improvements.
* Deliver reusable automation and observability patterns that reduce systemic toil and improve safe execution across teams.
* Publish and drive adoption of domain-level architecture, production-readiness, capacity, and resilience standards.
* Resolve one or more high-impact systemic risks and develop a prioritized multi-quarter improvement roadmap for the data-platform domain.

**7. What This Role Does Not Include**
======================================

* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is exercised through technical influence and mentorship.
* This is not a coordination-only role; the Staff DBRE must remain hands-on and capable of deep technical investigation.
* This role does not replace ownership held by application, SRE, infrastructure, network, storage, or cloud teams.
* This is not a ticket-queue role limited to incident response and routine operations; systemic improvement is expected.
* This role does not unilaterally define enterprise-wide cross-domain architecture or approval policy; that scope belongs to Principal-level and executive governance.

**8. Work Expectations and Location**
=====================================

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

You will work across Oracle and ServiceMax/SalesForce environments, combining functional understanding with hands-on technical troubleshooting. **Role Overview**

As an Oracle/ServiceMax Techno-Functional Engineer, you will support day-to-day operations, incident resolution, enhancements, and system stability across Oracle-related and ServiceMax processes. You will be an Oracle ERPs expert that extends the scope of this role to Salesforce and ServiceMax processes to ensure smooth processes execution through the ecosystem. You will translate business needs into practical solutions, validate fixes through testing, and help ensure reliable performance across integrated systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide techno-functional support for Oracle and ServiceMax users, resolving issues related to functionality, data accuracy, integrations, and performance.
* Analyze incidents, service requests, and enhancement needs, then define practical solutions that align with business and system requirements.
* Support configuration, testing, deployment, and release activities across Oracle and Salesforce/ServiceMax environments.

* Support ERP and field service process improvements by identifying opportunities for automation, simplification, and better user experience.

* Take ownership of enhancements and projects from triage through closure, with accountability, integrity, and a strong focus on system reliability.
* Stay close to the business process and user impact, removing friction for service and operations teams by prioritizing work that matters most.
* Use structured analysis, testing, and follow-up to improve every day through clear problem-solving, candor, and root-cause thinking.

* 3+ years of experience working in Agile and DevOps environments.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle EBS, PL/SQL, and SQL.
* Experience leading full lifecycle Oracle ERP implementations.
* Excellent communication skills in English.
* Experience in one or more of the following Oracle modules:
  + General Ledger (GL)

  + Procurement
